articles.title: India's GDP Growth for FY26 Estimated at 7.4%, Remains Fastest-Growing Major Economy
articles.summary: India reaffirms its status as the fastest-growing major economy for the fourth consecutive year with 7.4% GDP growth driven by consumption and investment. Manufacturing sector shows robust strength with 8.4% growth in first half.
key_points: GDP growth at 7.4% for FY26, fastest among major economies
Manufacturing growing at 8.4% in H1 FY26
Private consumption increased to 61.5% of GDP

articles.title: World Bank Projects India's GDP Growth at 7.6% for FY2025-26
articles.summary: World Bank's South Asia Economic Update estimates India's GDP growth at 7.6%, driven by strong private consumption, GST rationalization, and export resilience, with moderation to 6.6% expected in FY2026-27.
key_points: World Bank estimates 7.6% growth for FY25-26
India temporarily surpassed Japan as 4th largest economy in April 2025

articles.title: India-EU Free Trade Agreement: The 'Mother of All Deals' After 20 Years
articles.summary: India and EU announce historic free trade agreement after 20 years of negotiations, set to take effect in early 2027. Deal will significantly lower or cancel tariffs on over 90% of goods.
key_points: Historic FTA with EU after 20 years of negotiations
90% of goods to see tariff reductions or elimination
India to cut duties on EU alcohol, machinery, chemicals, aircraft
EU to ease access for Indian exports

articles.title: OECD Forecasts India as World's Fastest-Growing Major Economy Through 2028
articles.summary: OECD projects India's GDP growth at 7.6% for 2025-26, 6.1% for 2026-27, and 6.4% for 2027-28, maintaining position as world's fastest-growing major economy despite Middle East conflict challenges.
key_points: Middle East conflict poses risks to global economy
China's growth to ease from 5.0% to 4.3% by 2027

articles.title: India's Real GDP Revised Upward to 7.6% for FY 2025-26
articles.summary: Government revises GDP growth estimate to 7.6% from initial 7.4%, marking sharpest expansion since FY2022. Manufacturing sector achieves double-digit growth with strong performance from secondary and tertiary sectors.
key_points: New GDP base year 2022-23 for better accuracy

articles.title: India's Inflation Rate Rises to 3.4% in March 2026
articles.summary: Annual inflation rate in India increased to 3.4% in March from 3.21%, marking largest inflation rate in over a year but below market expectations. New CPI methodology updated weights based on latest consumption survey.
key_points: Inflation at 3.4% in March, up from 3.21%
Food inflation at 3.87%, picking up from 3.47%
New CPI weights updated based on consumption survey
Inflation remains within RBI's 2-6% target band

articles.title: India Reaffirms 4% Inflation Target with 2-6% Band Through 2031
articles.summary: Government extends flexible inflation targeting framework, maintaining 4% retail inflation goal with tolerance band of 2-6% for five years from April 2026 to March 2031, providing policy continuity.
key_points: Provides stability and predictability for markets

articles.title: India's Wholesale Inflation Rises to 2.13% in February 2026
articles.summary: Wholesale price inflation increased to 2.13% year-on-year in February, driven by higher prices of manufactured goods, metals, textiles, and certain primary articles. Fuel and power category shows negative inflation.
key_points: WPI inflation at 2.13% in February, up from 1.81%
Driven by manufactured goods, metals, textiles

articles.title: RBI Maintains Repo Rate at 5.25% with Neutral Stance in April 2026
articles.summary: Reserve Bank of India keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.25% in first bi-monthly monetary policy for FY27, maintaining neutral stance. MPC projects GDP growth at 6.9% amid Middle East conflict uncertainties.
key_points: Middle East conflict poses growth risks

articles.title: RBI Cuts Repo Rate to 5.25% in February 2026, First Cut in Cycle
articles.summary: Reserve Bank of India reduces repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.25% in February meeting, marking first rate cut after prolonged pause. Decision driven by softer inflation outlook and improving growth prospects.
key_points: First rate cut in current cycle

articles.title: RBI Projects Inflation at 4.6% for FY27 Amid El Niño Concerns
articles.summary: Monetary Policy Committee raises CPI inflation forecast to 4.6% for FY27 from average 1.9% in 11MFY26, citing El Niño conditions and Middle East conflict impacts. First-time core inflation projection given at 4.4%.
key_points: El Niño conditions may affect monsoon and food prices

articles.title: India Manufacturing Sector Records Double-Digit Growth in FY26
articles.summary: Manufacturing sector achieves double-digit growth rates in both FY23-24 and FY25-26, emerging as key contributor to India's resilient economic performance. Secondary and tertiary sectors exceed 9% growth.

articles.title: India Data Centre Capacity Leads Asia-Pacific, Surpasses Singapore
articles.summary: India emerges as leading data centre hub in Asia-Pacific region (excluding China) with 950 MW installed capacity, surpassing Singapore, Australia, and Japan. Additional 850 MW projected by 2026.
key_points: Leads Asia-Pacific region in data centres
Cloud services market to hit $13 billion by 2026

articles.title: India's External Sector Remains Comfortable with 11-Month Import Cover
articles.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves cover over 11 months of imports and approximately 94% of external debt, providing comfortable liquidity cushion. Current account deficit moderate at 0.8% of GDP in H1 FY26.
key_points: Forex reserves cover 11+ months of imports
Current account deficit at 0.8% of GDP

articles.title: India Stock Market Expected to Deliver Stronger Returns in 2026
articles.summary: Indian equities poised for robust performance in 2026 after underperforming in 2025, driven by improving corporate earnings, steady 7%+ GDP growth, attractive valuations, and supportive policies. Large-caps appear particularly attractive.

articles.title: Domestic Liquidity Cushions India Market Amid Foreign Selling Pressure
articles.summary: India stock market in 2026 shaped by contest between persistent foreign selling and strong domestic liquidity. Nifty 50 trading near 24,100 level with domestic flows large enough to cushion but not neutralize shocks.
key_points: Market repricing oil risk and rupee pressure

articles.title: GST 2.0 to Partially Offset U.S. Tariff Impact on India Economy
articles.summary: Positive momentum from GST 2.0 reforms expected to partially offset adverse impact of U.S. tariffs in coming quarters. Improving macro indicators and strong earnings could set stage for market rally from H2 2026.
key_points: GST 2.0 to help offset U.S. tariff impact
Consumption contribution to GDP at 4.4% by end-2026

articles.title: India's Consumption Drives 70% of GDP Under Economic Transformation
articles.summary: Consumer society firmly established with nearly 70% of GDP arising from domestic consumption, supported by rise in billionaires and increased incomes across economic spectrum. Trade volumes expanding in both imports and exports.
key_points: Rise in billionaires and broader income growth
Trade expansion in imports and exports
Leading industries: space, IT, pharmaceuticals, shipping

articles.title: SIP Flows Provide Steady Domestic Cushion to Indian Markets
articles.summary: Retail participation via Systematic Investment Plans held up well in 2025-26, providing steady domestic cushion to markets despite foreign institutional investor selling. Monthly SIP collections remain sizable.
key_points: Steady SIP flows despite FII selling

articles.title: India's Trade Exports Grow 2.4% Despite U.S. Tariffs in FY26
articles.summary: Merchandise exports grew 2.4% (April-December 2025) despite heightened U.S. tariffs, while services exports increased 6.5%. Trade deficit counterbalanced by services surplus and strong remittances.
key_points: Merchandise exports up 2.4% despite U.S. tariffs
